Name: Eliasaph, Son of Lael
Summary: Eliasaph, son of Lael, was the chief of the Gershonites, the Levites who carried the tabernacle's curtains and coverings.
KeyStory: Eliasaph oversaw the Gershonite families in their service of carrying the dwelling place of God.
LifeLesson: Not all service is seen — some of it is carrying the very walls of worship.
